root.name: トリニティ・インダストリーズ

rows.ja: 分離・投資パートナー
貨車の買い手・借り手(相手の資料に記載)
rows.en: Railcar buyers & lessees (named in their filings)

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2018年にTrinityから分離。分離時の知的財産契約などが続く
relations.text_en: Spun off from Trinity in 2018; separation agreements such as an IP matters agreement remain

source.label: Arcosa 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Intellectual Property Matters Agreement, dated as of October 31, 2018, by and between Trinity Industries, Inc. and Arcosa, Inc.

relations.text: 2013年からの貨車投資パートナー。持ち分を交換して貨車リース子会社を再編(2025年12月)
relations.text_en: Railcar investment partner since 2013; swapped stakes to restructure leasing partnerships (December 2025)

source.label: Trinity Industries 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: TILC completed a Sale and Exchange Agreement (the "Exchange Agreement") with Napier Park Railcar Lease Fund LLC ("Napier Park"), a subsidiary of Napier Park Global Capital, one of our railcar investment partners since 2013

relations.text: GATXが10-Kで、新しい貨車の購入先メーカーとして挙げる
relations.text_en: GATX buys new railcars from Trinity Rail

source.label: GATX 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Rail North America purchases new railcars from a number of manufacturers, including Trinity Rail Group, LLC ("Trinity"), a subsidiary of Trinity Industries, Inc.

relations.text: GATXが10-Kで、貨車リースの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: GATX names Trinity's leasing unit a primary railcar leasing competitor

source.label: GATX 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Rail North America's primary competitors in railcar leasing are Union Tank Car Company, CIT Rail, Trinity Industries Leasing Company, and American Industrial Transport.

companies.name: ハイウォーター・エタノール

relations.text: Highwater Ethanolが10-Kで、Trinityの貨車リース子会社との貨車リース契約を重要契約に挙げる
relations.text_en: Highwater Ethanol lists a railcar lease agreement with Trinity's leasing unit among its exhibits

source.label: Highwater Ethanol 10-K(2025年10月期)
source.quote: Trinity Industries Leasing Company Railroad Car Lease Agreement dated July 1, 2009.

relations.text: Lineageが10-Kで、冷蔵貨車リースの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Lineage names Trinity Rail its main competitor in refrigerated railcar leasing

source.label: Lineage 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in refrigerated rail car leasing, our main competitor is Trinity Rail.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
